name: REN - DEV - AUTH-01 - Provider OAuth Client Credentials_quicklink

parameters.content:
## AUTH-01 - Provider OAuth Client Credentials

Issues HS256 JWT access tokens at `POST /webhook/oauth/token-test` and verifies them at the existing `POST /webhook/renov/dev/v1/auth/verify` path.

Client secrets are stored only as SHA-256 digests. JWT signing material and all OAuth configuration come from `RENOV_OAUTH_*` environment variables.

Execution payload retention is disabled because token requests contain client credentials.
